About George

A new career chapter, backed by real-world experience.

Hey, I’m George.

I’m a General Virtual Assistant specializing in Administrative Support, Email Management Automation, Lead Generation, Project Management, Customer Support, and Graphic Design. I’m also doing online affiliate marketing as a side hustle.

For more than 10 years, I worked in the Production and Manufacturing Industry for a multinational company, where I developed strong discipline, attention to detail, time management, teamwork, and the ability to work under pressure.

Like many people, I spent years working 8-hour shifts—and sometimes even longer. I became good at what I did, but eventually, I realized that I wanted something more. I wanted to build a career where I could continue learning, use my creativity, and do work that genuinely inspires me. That realization led me to shift my career into the Virtual Assistant industry.

I may be starting a new chapter, but I’m bringing with me more than a decade of real-world work experience, a strong work ethic, and a willingness to learn. I’m not afraid of new challenges, new tools, or new responsibilities.

My goal is simple: to make your workload lighter, help you stay organized, and give you more time to focus on what truly matters—growing your business. Your business has goals. I’m here to help you achieve them.

Services

What Can I Do For You?

Practical support and automation for the recurring tasks that quietly take up your time—handled with care, organization, and attention to detail.

Administrative Support

I can assist with routine administrative work, stay organized, and handle tasks efficiently so you can focus on growing your business. I’m a fast learner, easy to train, and highly attentive to detail.

Customer Support

I can assist customers with patience, professionalism, and empathy, helping resolve concerns around refunds, transactions, orders, checkout, and other customer issues while keeping communication calm and positive.

Project Management

I can organize tasks, monitor progress, coordinate schedules, and keep projects moving smoothly so deadlines are visible, priorities are clear, and work stays on track.

Data Building & Research

I can handle routine data-building and research responsibilities so you can spend more time on strategy, growth, and priorities that move your business forward.

Personal Assistant

I can help prepare documents, create marketing materials, manage schedules, arrange travel, and handle other practical tasks that keep your day organized and productive.

Email Management Automation

I can help organize and automate email workflows, manage incoming messages, set up automated responses and follow-ups, and streamline repetitive email tasks so your inbox stays organized and important conversations don’t get missed.

Lead Management Automation

I can help capture, organize, track, and follow up with leads using automated workflows, keeping lead information organized and helping ensure prospects move smoothly through your sales process.

Graphic Design

I can create clean, professional visual materials for social posts, presentations, marketing assets, and other business needs using tools such as Canva.
